description: This file defines several stock move services in XML format, including methods for finding stock moves needed/recommended, processing stock moves, and retrieving inventory locations related to products or facilities. It contains definitions of functions used for inventory management and stock transfer within an application, specifically for the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: findStockMovesNeeded
methods.description: Finds all stock moves that need to be done based on inventory and order statuses, consolidating inventory data and generating move instructions.

methods.name: findStockMovesRecommended
methods.description: Calculates and identifies stock moves recommended based on ProductFacilityLocation minimum stock levels and inventory status, for pre-emptive replenishment.

methods.name: processPhysicalStockMove
methods.description: Processes a physical stock movement between locations within a facility, handling reservation updates, inventory adjustments, and related stock move records.

methods.name: processOisgirMoveByStatusInline
methods.description: Inline helper method to process stock moves for specific OrderItem.statusId, handling inventory reservation and transfer for serial and non-serial items.

methods.name: findProductInventorylocations
methods.description: Retrieves inventory locations for a specific product within a facility.
